newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal government to present budget draft Friday.
newsitem.headline: Portugal government to present budget draft Friday.

text.p: Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco will deliver a draft of the government's 1997 budget to opposition parties on Friday ahead of its formal approval by the cabinet, a ministerial spokesman said.
The minister was due to meet members of parliament at 0900 GMT.
The cabinet meeting to give final approval to the government plan to cut the deficit into line with Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) limits is set for next Monday.
The final blueprint will then be sent to parliament on Tuesday, the constitutional deadline for its delivery to the legislature.
